conclusion: Activation freeze is SECURE. All 4 mandatory gates, all 3 re-evaluation triggers, all 5 Agent V criteria, all 7 prohibited paths, and all 5 economic assumptions are exhaustively documented in the Activation Trigger Registry. Eleven distinct bypass scenarios were analyzed and all were found COVERED by either a documented trigger condition or a documented prohibited path. Two informational gaps were identified (stale economic value, amendment authority precision) — neither constitutes a freeze vulnerability. The registry is the single authoritative reference; any future activation requires satisfying documented trigger conditions and passing all 4 mandatory gates simultaneously under a new Executive Board vote.
